title: The battery's built-in manager
narration: A pack's cells need a supervisor: the battery management system. It constantly measures voltage, current and temperature to estimate how full the battery is and how healthy. No two cells are identical, so their charge drifts apart, and the weakest cell limits how much of the pack you can use. The manager balances them. If limits are crossed, it can cut power, and in a fault it disconnects the battery. It also runs heating and cooling, because heat wears cells out faster and cold saps their power.

visual_content.heading: What the battery manager does
bullets: Estimates charge level and battery health
Balances cells as they drift apart
Cuts power or disconnects on a fault
